That means an ET time on Mar 11 will already be in EDT (UTC-4) while our EU folks will still be on CET (UTC+1), so the offset becomes 5 hours for that week.

To avoid confusion, here are three practical options (all on Wed Mar 11 unless you prefer Thu):
- Option A (Engineer-friendly for EU): 11:00–11:45 ET / 16:00–16:45 CET — our EU eng team can attend fully.
- Option B (Exec-friendly for US, late for EU): 16:00–16:45 ET / 21:00–21:45 CET — later for EU but doable if engineers are OK with evening.
- Option C (Split-hosted, reduced live overlap): 09:30–10:00 ET / 14:30–15:00 CET — 30-min focused run for core team; we record for follow-up deep-dive.

If you'd like, we can rotate hosts with our EU folks on calls that fall outside their normal hours. We usually keep demos to 45 minutes when it's a heavy cross-region crowd.

I'm copying Soojin (EU engineering lead) and Karthik (sales engineering) so they can confirm coverage. Once we lock a slot I'll send a calendar invite (.ics) with both CET/EDT labels and a quick timezone-conversion image in the invite.

Thanks,
